data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Very disappointed with my experience…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a6a1fd39a4df936baeb3b9f)
Very disappointed with my experience this time around. I ordered three sconces, but only two were delivered, even though the tracking information showed that the entire order had arrived. I reached out through the online chat, but it was unhelpful and couldn’t resolve the issue. The only other customer support option was email, and responses have been incredibly slow. It’s now been over a week, and I still don’t have a resolution or my missing item. For a company with products at this price point, I expected much better customer service.

July 24, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 30, 2026

Kate,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the frustration and disappointment you've experienced with your recent order and our customer service. It's clear that we fell short of your expectations, and for that, we are truly sorry. We understand how frustrating it is to be missing an item and to not receive timely assistance. We are actively looking into your case to understand what went wrong and to expedite a resolution for your missing sconce. We appreciate your patience as we work to make this right.

Lulu and Georgia
